courses_thumbnail_metadata_complete.value: ("courses"."thumbnail_public_id" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_asset_id" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_secure_url" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_width" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_height" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_format" IS NULL) OR ("courses"."thumbnail_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_secure_url" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_width" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_height" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_format" IS NOT NULL)
courses_thumbnail_metadata_complete.name: courses_thumbnail_metadata_complete

courses_thumbnail_dimensions_positive.value: ("courses"."thumbnail_width" IS NULL AND "courses"."thumbnail_height" IS NULL) OR ("courses"."thumbnail_width" > 0 AND "courses"."thumbnail_height" > 0)
courses_thumbnail_dimensions_positive.name: courses_thumbnail_dimensions_positive

teacher_applications_review_state_check.name: teacher_applications_review_state_check
teacher_applications_review_state_check.value:
(
        "teacher_applications"."status" = 'pending'
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."review_notes" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "teacher_applications"."status" = 'approved'
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "teacher_applications"."status" = 'rejected'
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teacher_applications"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("teacher_applications"."rejection_reason")) > 0
      )
